description: Mosaic AI — Notion Model Context Protocol (MCP) Configuration Reference

notion.description: Official hosted remote Notion MCP server provided by Notion.
notes: Uses official OAuth flow managed by Notion.
Supported by modern MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, Goose).
Provides tools: notion-search, get_page, create_page, update_page, query_database.
IMPORTANT: Does NOT support microphone audio streaming, live meeting recording, or real-time calendar daemons.

notion-local-bridge.description: Optional local stdio Notion MCP server for local-only workflows.
